subject: spPGOcc :: Error in if (priors$phi.unif[1] == "fixed") { :    missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

messages.author: d97adc7d990b76a0
messages.subject: spPGOcc :: Error in if (priors$phi.unif[1] == "fixed") { :    missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Hi all,

I'm running a model in spPGOcc with the default priors from the tutorial. I was able to run this function yesterday successfully with a subset of the data. However, when I included all my data and run it with the default priors, I get this error:

Error in if (priors$phi.unif[1] == "fixed") { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I'm wondering if this issue is the prior itself or the way that I'm specifying it with the data that I have. Any help would be much appreciated. Below is the full code with the error message.

Best,
Matt


##full code




> # Define the formula for the detection and occupancy processes > det.formula <- ~ scale(slope)+scale(ordinal.date) +scale(effort)+scale(forcov) # Detection process formula > occ.formula <- ~ scale(elev) + scale(ag) + scale(FI) + scale(fordist) + scale(hfp) + scale(roads) > > # Compute distances between sites > distMat <- dist(GASP$coords) > > # Select exponential covariance model > cov.model <- "exponential" > > # Choose inits > # as in the model-fitting package vignette > TI.inits <- list(alpha = 0, + beta = 0, + z = apply(GASP$y, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE), + sigma.sq = 2, + phi = 3 / mean(distMat), + w = rep(0, nrow(GASP$y))) > > # Set some tuning param > TI.tuning <- list(phi = 1) > > # Define some priors (as in vignette) > min.dist <- min(distMat) > max.dist <- max(distMat) > > > TI.priors <- list(beta.normal = list(mean = 0, var = 5), + alpha.normal = list(mean = 0, var = 5), + sigma.sq.ig = c(2, 1), + phi.unif = c(3/max.dist, 3/min.dist)) > > out1sp <- spPGOcc(occ.formula = occ.formula, + det.formula = det.formula, + data = GASP, inits = TI.inits, + n.batch = 100, batch.length = 200, + priors = TI.priors, cov.model = cov.model, + NNGP = TRUE, n.neighbors = 5, tuning = TI.tuning, + n.samples = 5000, # 50000, + n.burn = 2000, #20000, + n.thin = 3, # 30, + n.chains = 3, + n.omp.threads = 3, + verbose = TRUE, + n.report = 1000) ---------------------------------------- Preparing to run the model ---------------------------------------- There are missing values in data$y with corresponding non-missing values in data$det.covs. Removing these site/replicate combinations for fitting the model. Error in if (priors$phi.unif[1] == "fixed") { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

messages.subject: Re: spPGOcc :: Error in if (priors$phi.unif[1] == "fixed") { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts: In the end I figured out what the issue was. I had NAs in my coordinates column which was creating NA distance values. That was at first causing the error, and then later causing R to crash.
